blurb: A {person} in a stained filter mask reads an air report and coughs.
option: Talk to the {person} in the filter mask
problem: Every breath on {market} burns. Our filters clog in days, and the children cough all year. {AStructure} project can clean the air.

blurb: A {person} reads a pressure chart and rubs a sore chest.
option: Talk to the {person} with the pressure chart
problem: The air on {market} presses down like deep water. People faint in the streets after an hour outside. {AStructure} project can let the extra air out.

blurb: A {person} with an oxygen mask around the neck studies a planetary survey.

problem: On {market} you can see the stars at noon. The air is so thin that our people wear pressure suits to cross the street. {AStructure} project can thicken it.
